reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was '200 mg' on the front, and then that it is two capsules of 100 mg each, which is exactly what I watch for. A brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal does not replace my Thorne, and at a dollar a serving I would be paying more than I pay now.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the company's own batch report is nice, but I cannot judge who the lab is or whether the report is real, and $29.99 for 30 days is pricey for a brand I have never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal, or a few hundred honest reviews, plus a lower price per serving or a cheaper trial size.
